model: CFB current-season performance rating, opponent-adjusted (scores + yards composite)
method: Composite of two least-squares opponent-adjusted ratings - scoring margin and total-yardage margin, standardized and equally weighted, shown on the scoring rating point scale - over every 2026 FBS final through 2026-10-19 (510 games, all opponents connected through the full schedule). Only the 138-team FBS set is ranked. Current-season performance only: no preseason talent, returning-production, portal, draft or AP-poll inputs, and no prior-season results. Values sit on a points-style rating scale centered on the average FBS team, not yet validated as a calibrated expected margin; fitted home-field is 3.9 points. The AP-fit column is a separately trained research variant that failed its Week 7 gate; the fixed-reference column is the sealed Oct 11 forecast specification (which does use preseason inputs) shown for audit only. Neither is a validated betting edge.
